name: detection-fixture-ambiguous
description: Intentionally ambiguous fixture: an Astro project with a stray next.config.mjs and a shared src/pages directory, so both "astro" and "next" score non-trivially. a11yst's HOST_PRIORITY places "next" above "astro", so "next" wins deterministically even though it has no "next" dependency and a lower raw score — this should surface a FRAMEWORK_AMBIGUOUS diagnostic with "astro" listed as the top alternative.
